name: PF Session Follow-up
description: One run per session: Slack DM with yes/no links, reminder, edits the message after the answer, marks showed_up / no_show / unanswered. Sub-workflow. DWN-6.

parameters.content:
## PF Session Follow-up
Input: `{ invitee_uri, mode }`. One run per session.

The question is a Slack DM with two **links** (not buttons), so clicks never reach the recruiting interactivity handler. Each link resumes this run with `answer=yes` or `answer=no`. After the answer or the timeout, the message is edited: links removed, answer shown.

No answer: one reminder (mock 3 min, real 24 h), then `unanswered`. Only an explicit `yes` / `no` counts as an answer.

smtp.name: SMTP Mailgun n8n official (use it with "info.n8n.io")

parameters.query:
-- Column aliases keep the names the code nodes used with the mock table.
SELECT id, invitee_uri, booking_status, followup_status, rebook_status,
       organizer_email AS host_email, organizer_name AS host_name,
       title AS event_name, external_id AS event_uri,
       -- ISO text, the same format the code read from the mock table (DateTime.fromISO).
       to_char(starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS starts_at,
       to_char(ends_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS ends_at,
       participant_name, participant_first_name, participant_email,
       booking_link, reward_amount, reward_order_id, is_mock
FROM calendar_research_sessions
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE calendar_research_sessions
SET followup_status = 'showed_up',
    showup_answered_at = now(),
    updated_at = now()
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
RETURNING id;

UPDATE calendar_research_sessions
SET followup_status = 'no_show',
    showup_answered_at = now(),
    updated_at = now()
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
RETURNING id;

UPDATE calendar_research_sessions
SET followup_status = 'reminded',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
RETURNING id;

UPDATE calendar_research_sessions
SET followup_status = 'unanswered',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
RETURNING id;

UPDATE calendar_research_sessions
SET followup_status = $2,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
RETURNING id;

UPDATE calendar_research_sessions
SET rebook_status = 'approved',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
RETURNING id;

UPDATE calendar_research_sessions
SET rebook_status = 'declined',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
RETURNING id;

UPDATE calendar_research_sessions
SET rebook_status = 'unanswered',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
RETURNING id;

UPDATE calendar_research_sessions
SET rebook_status = 'sent',
    noshow_email_sent_at = now(),
    updated_at = now()
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
RETURNING id;

UPDATE calendar_research_sessions
SET rebook_status = 'guard_blocked',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
RETURNING id;

UPDATE calendar_research_sessions
SET followup_status = 'host_not_found',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
RETURNING id;

nodeGroups.name: Check session
nodeGroups.description: Loads config and the session row from Supabase, checks it is active and the host passes the guard, builds texts and messages.

nodeGroups.name: Ask host
nodeGroups.description: DMs the host a yes/no question (links or buttons), waits until the session end, then edits the message to show the answer.

nodeGroups.name: Reminder
nodeGroups.description: No first answer: asks once more (mock 3 min, real 24 h), then edits the message.

nodeGroups.name: Joined
nodeGroups.description: Marks showed_up, waits until the session end, then starts PF Reward.

nodeGroups.name: Ask before rebook email
nodeGroups.description: Marks no_show, asks the host if the participant should get a rebook email, edits the message with the decision.

nodeGroups.name: Prepare rebook email
nodeGroups.description: Host said yes: marks approved, builds the email, applies the guard.

nodeGroups.name: Send rebook email
nodeGroups.description: Sends from noreply@info.n8n.io through Mailgun, stamps the row, edits the DM with the send time.

nodeGroups.name: Email blocked
nodeGroups.description: Guard or missing data: nothing sent, row marked guard_blocked, DM says why.

nodeGroups.name: Host not in Slack
nodeGroups.description: Host email has no Slack user: row marked host_not_found, the admin gets a DM. Nothing is sent to the participant.
